method.design: full-cluster census (no sampling): all 368 MEDNLP items judged
method.groups: 28 bounded subagent groups (max 18 items; grouped by section, sections never merged)
method.judges: 28 independent general-purpose subagents reading destination notes and grepping the vault for surface forms + alternative terminology before any absent verdict
method.depth_standard: campaign plan section 5 (what it is / why it exists / how it works conceptually / relations to other concepts; project usage not required for 'covered')
method.evidence_rule: covered/equivalent/partial require a verbatim quote (>= 12 words for covered/equivalent) mechanically validated as a whitespace-normalized substring of the cited note (scripts/s32_validate_judgments.py, exit 0: 368/368 PASSED)

orchestrator_rereview.method: stratified even-spaced sample (every 9th record of the 368, 41 items = 11.1%): 23 absent verified by independent orchestrator greps of the agent search terms (all hits confirmed false positives: 'fluid' matching LUI, teacher-forcing 'instructor', image-anisotropy vs representation anisotropy, mermaid 'graph TD' declarations); 18 covered/partial/equivalent verified by reading the cited destination notes and judging the verdict + quote depth against the campaign depth standard
orchestrator_rereview.notes: The 41-item sample spans all 18 MEDNLP sections and all four verdicts (12 covered / 4 partial / 2 equivalent / 23 absent). Notable confirmed judgment calls: Top-K Candidate Retrieval covered via the canonical retrieval-step explanation in Cosine Similarity.md; DAGs covered via the computational-graph treatment; Explainable AI equivalent under the vault's 'interpretability' terminology; Bootstrap Confidence Intervals equivalent under 'The bootstrap'; Graph Explainability absent (interpretability notes cover CNNs/LLMs, no graph-model explainability); Domain-Specific BERT partial (troubleshooting row only — BioBERT/ClinicalBERT family absent).

limitations: single-judge-per-item design mitigated by mandatory multi-term search before absent verdicts + the 11.1% orchestrator re-review; borderline covered/partial calls carry uncertainty noted by judges
judgments reflect the vault as of session 31 state (no vault mutations occurred during judging)
'covered' does not include project usage; project context integration happens in the S37+ execution waves
